# crosswork_golden_config_global_variables (Data Source)

This data source can read a global variable of Golden Configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crosswork_golden_config_global_variables" "example" {
  id = "cwtest_ntp_server"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The id of the object, the variable name

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `in_use` (Boolean) Whether the controller reports the variable as used; it is not reliable, a variable a template uses can show false
- `name` (String) Variable name
- `type` (String) Type of the value
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Value of the variable; the controller returns it in clear text
- `variable_id` (String) The id the controller gave the variable
